After marking ffn_moe_swiglu-* GLU outputs, handoff profile has shape_ok=720/720 with ptr_match=720, layer_match=720, width_match=720, nonzero_up_serial=720.

Native down probe independently shows down_src1_is_act=1118/1118, act_src0_is_gate=1118/1118, act_src1_is_up=1118/1118, so the explicit graph has the correct producer/consumer relation for a retained down microbench.
This is not a token-rate SOTA. It only fixes the profiler/handoff evidence needed for the next default-off retained down consume microbench.
